title: Meta neural trojan detection (MNTD)
description: Learn what a trojaned model looks like from the outside. The defender trains its own shadow models, half clean and half trojaned with triggers drawn from a broad random distribution, then jointly learns a few query inputs and a meta-classifier that separates the two groups from their outputs on those queries. The meta-classifier then scores the models under test. Because the shadow triggers span patches, scattered pixels and blends, it should generalize to a trigger family it never saw. Prediction: higher AUROC than mask-search trigger reconstruction on the held-out family.

source.title: Detecting AI Trojans Using Meta Neural Analysis
source.authors: Xu, Wang, Li, Borisov, Gunter, Li
